BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE diagnostic_assessment_plan (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY, student_id uuid NOT NULL, course_id uuid NOT NULL,
    plan_revision integer NOT NULL, idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL, request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    course_content_revision varchar(72) NOT NULL, policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    plan_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    onboarding_version bigint NOT NULL, bootstrap_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
    bootstrap_context_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL, bootstrap_binding_revision bigint NOT NULL,
    bootstrap_binding_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL, bootstrap_binding_created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, bootstrap_binding_goal_code varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    bootstrap_binding_direction_code varchar(128) NOT NULL,
    plan_json jsonb NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT uq_diagnostic_plan_student_key UNIQUE(student_id,idempotency_key),
    CONSTRAINT uq_diagnostic_plan_revision UNIQUE(student_id,course_id,bootstrap_context_digest,plan_revision),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_plan_revision CHECK(plan_revision >= 1),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_plan_hashes CHECK(request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND course_content_revision ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND plan_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND bootstrap_context_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND bootstrap_binding_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_plan_bootstrap CHECK(onboarding_version>=1 AND bootstrap_policy_version='diagnostic-bootstrap-v1' AND bootstrap_binding_revision>=1 AND date_trunc('microseconds', bootstrap_binding_created_at)=bootstrap_binding_created_at AND bootstrap_binding_goal_code<>'' AND bootstrap_binding_direction_code<>''),
    CONSTRAINT ck_diagnostic_plan_json CHECK(jsonb_typeof(plan_json)='object' AND (plan_json - 'schema' - 'id' - 'student_id' - 'course_id' - 'plan_revision' - 'policy_version' - 'course_content_revision' - 'plan_digest' - 'onboarding_version' - 'bootstrap_policy_version' - 'bootstrap_context_digest' - 'assessments' - 'created_at')='{}'::jsonb AND plan_json->>'schema'='diagnostic-assessment-plan.v1' AND plan_json->>'id'=id::text AND plan_json->>'student_id'=student_id::text AND plan_json->>'course_id'=course_id::text AND plan_json->>'plan_revision'=plan_revision::text AND plan_json->>'policy_version'=policy_version AND plan_json->>'course_content_revision'=course_content_revision AND plan_json->>'plan_digest'=plan_digest AND plan_json->>'onboarding_version'=onboarding_version::text AND plan_json->>'bootstrap_policy_version'=bootstrap_policy_version AND plan_json->>'bootstrap_context_digest'=bootstrap_context_digest AND CASE WHEN plan_json->>'created_at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?Z$' THEN (plan_json->>'created_at')::timestamptz = created_at ELSE false END AND jsonb_typeof(plan_json->'assessments')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(plan_json->'assessments') BETWEEN 3 AND 5)
);
COMMENT ON TABLE diagnostic_assessment_plan IS 'Immutable placement-only diagnostic plan receipt. Retakes require a future explicit supersession command.';
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_assessment_plan() RETURNS trigger AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'diagnostic assessment plans are immutable'; RETURN OLD; END; $$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
CREATE TRIGGER trg_protect_diagnostic_assessment_plan BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON diagnostic_assessment_plan FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_diagnostic_assessment_plan();
COMMIT;
